model_annotation: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the number of participants for various categories. The vertical axis lists the categories in descending order, while the horizontal axis represents the number of participants, labeled "Number of Participants" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6. The categories and their corresponding participant counts are as follows: Veracity Explanation has 1 participant, represented by a short green bar; Filters has 2 participants, represented by a slightly longer green bar; Overall Summary has 3 participants, represented by a teal-colored bar; Clarity and Simplicity has 3 participants, also represented by a teal-colored bar; Relevance Explanation has 5 participants, represented by a longer blue bar; FC Summary has 6 participants, represented by an even longer dark blue bar; and Relevant FCs also has 6 participants, represented by the longest purple bar. Notably, the bars are sorted in descending order of participant count, with no additional visual emphasis or annotations.
